sections.heading: What it is
sections.text: A scikit-learn TF-IDF + logistic-regression screener over UCC borrower and lender NAMES (word 1–2-grams on the normalised name, character 3–5-grams on the raw name, separate borrower and lender blocks). It is a **review queue over rules-rejected cases plus a second opinion on rules-accepted ones**. It never replaces the frozen rules, never changes `scope_all`, the headline counts or the existing map. A score indicates evidence of relevance under the written screening policy; it does not establish collateral, equipment ownership, loan amount, active debt or creditworthiness.

sections.heading: Data and labels
sections.text:
- Candidates: 1,226,257 filing-borrower cases (dataset `v1`, sha256 `0d508c2b85a7…`), by region {'CO': 905197, 'CT': 321060}.
- Labels: policy `mixed by round -- main_v1: label_policy_v2; pilot_v1: label_policy_v1`; **mixed by round -- main_v1: model-labelled, two independent blind passes, disagreements retained as unresolved; pilot_v1: model-labelled, founder-adjudicated** — two independent blind Claude passes labelled every case under the written policy; nothing was labelled by looking anything up. The rounds were NOT labelled under one arrangement, so each is stated separately:
  - `pilot_v1` (240 rows, policy `label_policy_v1`): model-labelled, founder-adjudicated; the founder decided all 5 of the 5 pass disagreements; 0 of the 40 rows selected for the founder audit were audited.
  - `main_v1` (2,880 rows, policy `label_policy_v2`): model-labelled, two independent blind passes, disagreements retained as unresolved; all 83 pass disagreements were retained as unresolved (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, counted in n_h) and none was adjudicated; 0 of the 120 rows selected for the founder audit were audited.
- Label statistics: by status {'blind_repeat': 520, 'blind_unresolved': 83, 'founder_adjudicated': 5, 'founder_confirmed': 0, 'model_agreed': 2512}; by round {'main_v1': 2880, 'pilot_v1': 240}; pass agreement {'main_v1': {'agreed': 2317, 'n': 2400, 'rate': 0.9654166666666667}, 'pilot_v1': {'agreed': 195, 'n': 200, 'rate': 0.975}}; founder audit {'main_v1': {'agreement_rate': None, 'n_audited': 0, 'n_confirmed': 0, 'n_overturned': 0, 'n_selected': 120}, 'pilot_v1': {'agreement_rate': None, 'n_audited': 0, 'n_confirmed': 0, 'n_overturned': 0, 'n_selected': 40}}; blind-repeat consistency {'pass_a': {'consistent': 260, 'n': 260, 'rate': 1.0}, 'pass_b': {'consistent': 260, 'n': 260, 'rate': 1.0}}.
- Labelled cases by split {'train': 1400, 'validation': 400, 'test': 800}, of which resolved (RELEVANT / NOT_RELEVANT) {'train': 820, 'validation': 207, 'test': 453}.
- Groups are region-scoped borrower groups; splits {'test': 240980, 'train': 801607, 'validation': 183670} rows / {'test': 100069, 'train': 325224, 'validation': 75052} groups.

sections.heading: Training
sections.text:
- Variant `borrower_lender`, C = 10.0 (grid [0.1, 1.0, 10.0], **at a grid boundary: widening the grid is a founder decision**), class_weight none, sample weight 1/inclusion_probability per row (mean 1 within each fit), seed 20260912, StratifiedGroupKFold(5) inside TRAIN, selected by weighted_average_precision.
- Calibration `sigmoid` on group-separated out-of-fold TRAIN scores (135.4 Kish effective positives); validation weighted ECE 0.032, decision-region (score ≥ 0.3) weighted ECE 0.057 → score_type `calibrated_probability`.
- Out-of-fold raw-score SD 3.401 vs refit TRAIN raw-score SD 3.631 (ratio 1.068): the calibrator learned the fold models' score scale, so a ratio above 1 makes the refit's probabilities slightly overconfident.
- 20,873 features; feature policy `features_v1`; scikit-learn 1.9.1, Python 3.14.7.

sections.heading: Threshold (chosen on VALIDATION, before TEST)
sections.text:
- Objective: max weighted recall s.t. weighted precision ≥ 0.95 with ≥ 30 predicted positives counted as the Kish effective number, and a one-sided 95% lower bound of weighted precision at or above the same floor.
- Threshold 0.8612 → status **experimental** (fallback: precision_lower_bound_or_effective_support_below_floor; the rules remain authoritative).
- Validation: wP 1.000 (one-sided 95% lower bound 0.816), wR 0.646, Kish effective predicted positives 30.1, 51 predicted positives of n = 207 (selection-biased upward: the threshold was chosen on this sample; the TEST rows below are the unbiased estimate).
- Validation was looked at 1 time(s) before this release.

sections.heading: Test result (one run, held-out borrower groups, design-weighted, 95% Jeffreys cluster-bootstrap intervals)
sections.text:
- Primary (pre-registered): review-queue weighted precision (model suggestions among rules-rejected cases) 0.000 [0.028, 0.948] (estimate outside interval) over 216 resolved rules-rejected cases.
- n = 453 resolved cases (243 positive); design-weighted unresolved share 0.477 [0.417, 0.533]; unresolved share among model suggestions 0.028.

| | weighted precision | weighted recall | weighted F1 | TP/FP/FN/TN |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| model | 0.998 [0.872, 0.995] (estimate outside interval) | 0.795 [0.689, 0.842] | 0.885 [0.795, 0.902] | 170/1/73/209 |
| frozen rules | 0.991 [0.952, 0.996] | 0.969 [0.821, 0.968] (estimate outside interval) | 0.980 [0.892, 0.978] (estimate outside interval) | 235/2/8/208 |

- Secondary: paired delta (model − rules) precision 0.007 [-0.111, 0.023] (not distinguishable), recall -0.173 [-0.216, -0.046] (lower); two comparisons, not multiplicity-adjusted.
- Per region:
  - CO: n=248, model wP 0.998 [0.875, 0.998], wR 0.817 [0.712, 0.871]; rules wP 0.991 [0.949, 0.998], wR 0.968 [0.833, 0.978]
  - CT: n=205, model wP 1.000 [0.523, 0.998] (estimate outside interval), wR 0.584 [0.391, 0.728]; rules wP 0.992 [0.950, 0.998], wR 0.973 [0.519, 0.975]

sections.heading: Limitations
sections.text:
- A figure marked `(estimate outside interval)` is not a contradiction to reconcile: the point estimate is the design-weighted plug-in, while the interval is smoothed by a Jeffreys prior that keeps a cell with no observed error uncertain, so at the boundary the smoothed interval ends below an unsmoothed 1.000. Read the interval, not the point, wherever the mark appears.
- Inputs are names only: no collateral text (CO's field is a 124-value category list, CT has none), no documents.
- Rates estimate performance on the RESOLVABLE population (cases a screener could label RELEVANT or NOT_RELEVANT), design-weighted by 1 / inclusion_probability — the sampling rate of the (split, stratum, screen cell) each case was actually drawn from, since the boundary screen puts several rates inside one stratum. N_h / n_h is reported per stratum as that stratum's AVERAGE weight and is applied to no row. The INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE share of the population and of the model's suggestions is reported above with its interval.
- The split is by borrower group within this snapshot; it is not a chronological forecast and not a transfer claim to other states.
- Linear feature contributions describe the model's calculation, not independent evidence about the business.
- Cross-register (CO↔CT) entity linking, entity resolution and active-loan status are out of scope (v1 screens historical observations).
